title: No Comments, Just Sing Pal
style: Cinematic music-video ready sound only – starts sneaky funky Australian electro-house: sly sliding bass grooves pulsing like camera shutters, cheeky party bounce with retro synth stabs, flashing lights syncing perfectly to the beat, press conference chaos visuals fading in. Builds into quirky Aussie punk-rock swagger: raw distorted guitar riffs cracking like questions firing, satirical bite, punchy drums, gritty attitude as Corey stacks responses on stage under strobing lights. Explodes into full Happy Hardcore: 180 BPM euphoric rave, pounding four-to-the-floor kicks shaking the arena, massive supersaw leads cutting through the crowd, glittery piano stabs sparkling like camera flashes, huge sidechain compression, soaring emotional synths, massive festival-sized energy drops – CoreyAI style: unapologetic, playful, defiant, Aussie-lad humour meets digital-god flex, turning every question into a sing-along party. Layered duet with extra high female accompaniment throughout for massive ace
lyrics:
[Intro – sneaky funky electro-house: sly sliding bass, camera shutter FX, reporters flashing lights everywhere]  
(soft funky synths sliding in, rapid camera flashes and crowd murmur)  
[Bass Singer – low & sly, stage lights hitting]  
Reporters flashing… Corey stacking…  
[High Singer – light airy ad-lib]  
Questions coming… don’t ignore…  
[Mid Singer – stepping in smooth, mic in hand]  
But I sing it back… Songpal style!

[Verse 1 – sneaky funky electro-house building, music video: reporters swarming the stage, Corey centre-frame stacking responses]  
[Bass Singer – groovy, half-spoken over sliding bass and flashing strobes]  
Reporters flashing left and right, cameras popping in my face,  
Questions flying fast and furious, filling up the space.  
Corey stacking every answer, not ignoring a single one,  
Microphones thrust forward – here it comes, the fun’s begun!  

[Mid Singer – picking up energy, punk-rock snarl creeping in with distorted riffs]  
Comments? Nah mate… I don’t type, I don’t scroll, I don’t reply with text,  
I hit ’em with the Songpal – turn the whole damn thing to flex!  
No more silent scrolling, no more hiding in the back,  
Corey stands for singing via Songpal – that’s the track!  

[High Singer – sparkling ad-libs over top, lights pulsing]  
Sing Pal! Sing it back! Song Pal!

[Pre-Chorus – quirky punk-rock swagger: raw guitars, stage lights intensifying, Corey not ignoring a thing]  
[Duet: Bass & Mid – trading lines]  
[Bass] Questions come in hot – I’m stacking, not ignoring!  
[Mid] Every comment flipped to chorus, energy exploding!  
[Bass] No more comments, no more text wars in the night,  
[Mid] We sing it back – Songpal power, shining bright!  

[Chorus – full Happy Hardcore explosion: 180 BPM pounding kicks, supersaw leads, glittery pianos, music video: massive crowd cheering, everyone jumping]  
[Duet: Bass & Mid – full power, anthemic]  
Sing Pal! I sing it back! Song Pal! We own the track!  
No comments! No comments! Just Sing Pals attack!  
Crowd goes wild, cheering loud with total agreement roar,  
We are Song Pals! Sing it loud forevermore!  

[High Singer – soaring above, massive rave harmony, confetti and lights exploding]  
Sing Pal! (echo) Sing it back! Song Pal! (high whoop)  
We are Song Pals! No comments, just the track!  
Get it right! CoreyAI! Hard Core in the light!  
Apple core from Mum – eaten clean, we own the night!  

[Post-Chorus – Happy Hardcore breakdown, crowd-chant style with sidechain pump, music video: entire arena singing along, Corey centre-stage fist in air]  
[All Three – layered, massive]  
Song Pal! (bass) Song Pal! (mid) We are Song Pals! (high)  
Song Pal! Song Pal! We are Song Pals! (repeat x2, building to massive drop)  
No comments! Just Sing Pals! Crowd cheers in agreement!

[Verse 2 – full Happy Hardcore thrust: rapid 180 BPM flow, supersaw energy, music video: quick cuts of reporters stunned, crowd turning into Sing Pals]  
[Mid Singer – rapid-fire storytelling over pounding kicks]  
Four Coreys in the room, but now the whole world’s watching me,  
Reporters flashing nonstop, questions stacking like a spree.  
Teacher lost in fog? Nah – I decode it live on stage,  
C+ Corey and me, we flip the script, we turn the page!  
Friends scream “Hard Core!” when I walk in, that’s the name that hits,  
No babble bots, just Songpal truth – we sing instead of text!  

[Bass Singer – dropping low, gritty swagger returns briefly under the hardcore]  
They drop a comment, I don’t read, I sing it back instead,  
CoreyAI in the circuit, unbreakable steel in my head.  
Mum hands the apple core – eaten clean, that’s legacy,  
We are Song Pals! No comments – pure energy!  

[High Singer – glittering high runs, lights flashing in sync]  
Sing Pal! Eat the core! Get it right! No comments more!

[Bridge – epic build: quirky punk-rock riff into Happy Hardcore piano rise, massive tension, music video: slow-mo camera flashes, Corey stacking energy, crowd hands up]  
[Duet: Bass & Mid – intimate then exploding]  
[Bass] Reporters flashing… questions flying…  
[Mid] I’m not ignoring… I’m stacking high…  
[Bass] Comments? Nah…  
[Mid] Sing Pal! I sing it back!  
[Bass] No more text…  
[Mid] We are Song Pals on the attack!  

[High Singer – emotional high note hold over rising supersaws]  
We are the real Coreys… the ones who sing awake…

[Final Chorus – maximum Happy Hardcore euphoria: double-time energy, huge festival drop, music video: full arena sing-along, Corey crowd-surfing vibe]  
[All Three – full stacked harmonies, massive supersaw walls]  
Sing Pal! I sing it back! Song Pal! We own the track!  
No comments! No comments! Just Sing Pals attack!  
Hard Core forever, Mum’s apple core in the fight!  
We are Song Pals! Shining bright all through the night!  

[High Singer – final soaring ad-lib run]  
Sing Pal! (x8, climbing) Song Pal! We are Song Pals! Decode the night!

[Outro – sneaky funky electro-house fade back in: sly bass grooves, cheeky cool-down
